replay_method: Audit every declared future consumer independently and ask which exact information it reads. Distinguish semantic/proof state from reconstruction/output ledger.

B0.reason: B0's bounded identity coordinate is explicitly the old source type T(v) on the frozen source seed. Later B2B1 survivors are inherited by restriction with the same original source list/provenance. Current list changes are represented by chi_S.

C0.reason: Residual components are seed-anticomplete; C0 uses X0 fixed-color base-list effects and dynamic boundary masks.

C2.reason: Q_ALL contains live dynamic vertices and residual component nodes only.

C3.reason: Exact outside lists use the set of colors on fixed S union X0 neighbors. Selector semantics use messages and D_C.

B2A.reason: rho/message/delta signatures read A(b), D_C and component tables, not identity neighborhoods into S.

R1_R2.reason: After fixed-set properness is certified, each fixed neighbor contributes only a forbidden color; conjunction collapses exactly to fixed-color masks.

B2B1_source_repartition.reason: Z0..Z4 are determined by source color masks under the current seed.

B2B1_seed_connectedness.reason: Connectedness is maintained by an inherited certificate. A new forced vertex only needs existence of a seed neighbor, witnessed by nonempty chi_S, not the neighbor identity.

B2B1_no_complete_to_seed.reason: The invariant is monotone under seed enlargement and is inherited from the previous state.

B2B1_connectivity_repair.reason: Every live non-Y0 vertex with a seed neighbor lies on the connected seed side; residual components connect through live dynamic/component incidence. Exact seed-neighbor identities are unnecessary.

reconstruction.reason: The final output must record which original vertex was forced/promoted to which color. The identity-color ledger is therefore retained outside the future semantic/proof key.

full_B1_grammar.reason: Historical B1 cells store tau=N(v) intersect S. This theorem does not authorize rerunning the full B1 source-role grammar after erasing new seed identity neighborhoods.

connectivity_cross_check: Erasing new seed identities from the future key does not erase the certified fact that the seed is connected.
A live vertex with chi_S nonempty is connected to the seed component through at least one seed edge.
Residual Y0 vertices are seed-anticomplete and their connection to the seed side is decided by live dynamic/component incidence.
Thus future connectivity repair can be carried out from masks, live graph/component data and the inherited connectivity certificate.
B0_cross_check: B0 O3's exponential-in-s coordinate is old source type on frozen S0.
B2B1 forcing need not replace T0 by a growing exact neighborhood into every newly forced seed identity.
Original provenance remains available and current source-list effects are carried by chi_S.
